Title: Admin Configuration Surface Current State
Content: The /admin workbench is the authenticated Admin surface for users, OAuth sign-in provider enablement, chat model profiles, configuration, audit, and history. The Models tab uses ChatModelProfileService to manage MemorySmith:Chat:ModelProfiles, DefaultModelProfileId, and maintenance-agent model assignment ids in appsettings.LocalDevelopment.json or MemorySmith:SettingsOverridePath; admins can define profile name, provider, provider-discovered model selection, optional context-window tokens, enabled state, default chat profile, maintenance-run/proposal-review/Admin Maintenance chat assignments, role allowlist, and description. Model creation/editing resolves the selected provider through IChatProvider and populates the model dropdown with ListModelsAsync results, including Ollama api/tags and GitHub/Copilot SDK model discovery paths, while preserving a configured model id if discovery is temporarily unavailable. Tag governance remains a separate Admin-only main navigation page at /tags rather than an Admin tab. Configuration rows come from AdminSettingsService.ListEditableSettings, persist through AdminSettingsService.UpdateAsync into the same override settings file, reload IConfigurationRoot, and record settings.updated audit entries. The Configuration tab covers broad MemorySmithOptions groups and each editable row exposes an info-circle tooltip sourced from AdminSettingItem.HelpText. Each row shows the friendly setting name plus info icon first and the configuration key on the following line. Sensitive values such as API keys, OAuth secrets, bootstrap token hashes, and database connection strings are write-only in the UI: the table reports Configured or Not configured but does not echo the stored value.
